has_wonder.semantics: returns bit0 if the leader owns a completed building of that wonder type assigned to a city (BuildData::city >= 0), except REDFORT(534) which is exempt from the city test; returns bit1 if LeaderData::conquest_wonders (BitMask<17> payload +0x6D74) has the bit AND epoch[Civic] >= ctw_wonder_min_civics(4). Callers test != 0 unless noted.

has_tribe_bonus.semantics: false if game option [0x00C061E8+0x80] & 4, or the leader has no tribe; true if LeaderData::conquest_racial_powers (BitMask<24> payload +0x6D94) has the bit; false if LeaderData flags byte +4 & 0x40; otherwise tribes[leader.tribe].bonus_id (+0x54, stride 0x5F0) == arg.
